references.context: Shoot the Gold Mine to light Lock, then shoot the lit Gold Mine to lock a ball.
references.label: Gold Mine entrance
references.description: The mine entrance is the upper-left shot.

references.context: A Bounty award or the Lasso Skill Shot can also lock a ball.
references.label: Bounty collect
references.description: The Bounty award is collected beneath the Bart Brothers.

references.context: A Bounty award or the Lasso Skill Shot can also lock a ball.
references.label: Lasso skill-shot bowl
references.description: The shooter lane feeds the lasso bowl for the skill shot.

references.context: Test both orbit kickouts and the Gold Mine return.
references.label: Orbit kickouts
references.description: The left and right orbit exits return the ball to the flippers.

references.context: Roll through the lit inlane to raise a Bad Guy.
references.label: Quick Draw inlane
references.description: The lit inlane connected to a completed target bank raises its Bad Guy.

references.context: In Showdown, clear a drop set, then make a lit Jackpot shot. Complete the sequence, hit Boss Bart for the Super Jackpot, and shoot Victory Laps.
references.label: Bart and Saloon
references.description: Bart rises in front of the Saloon in the upper-right-center area.

references.context: Complete the left target bank or right target bank to light its inlane.
references.label: Left Quick Draw bank
references.description: The left three-target bank raises a Quick Draw Bad Guy through its lit inlane.

references.context: Complete the left target bank or right target bank to light its inlane.
references.label: Right Quick Draw bank
references.description: The right three-target bank raises a Quick Draw Bad Guy through its lit inlane.

references.context: Hit the Beer Mug for the one cashout.
references.label: Beer Mug target
references.description: The Beer Mug standup is beside the lower-right return.
